content: NHSN Reports Print Minus Related Pages This page contains surveillance reports published by CDC using data from the National Healthcare Safety Network (NHSN). Reports are organized by topic, and include summaries of healthcare-associated infections, antimicrobial use and resistance, healthcare personnel influenza vaccination rates, and dialysis events. NHSN recognizes that changes to the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) payment policies and changes in state and local reporting mandates may impact the number and characteristics of healthcare facilities participating in NHSN.
